summary: Cincinnati's Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) missed Wednesday practice, Chicago's backfield tilted toward Kyle Monangai after Swift's fumble, and the Colts are thin at receiver with Pierce on IR.

NFL|00-0036997|rry.note: Williams has 83, 50, 103 and 83 scrimmage yards in 2026, so 93.5 sits above his usual output; Dallas is a 7.5 to 10 point favorite over 0-4 Tampa and rookie QB Daniels.

NFL|00-0035358|kpts.note: McLaughlin missed Tuesday practice with a groin/hip issue but came off the report; he is 9 for 9 on field goals, though Tampa scored little with Daniels and has an implied total near 18.

NFL|00-0036389|car.note: Hurts is healthy, but Barkley (hamstring) is uncertain and Bigsby is on IR, leaving Will Shipley as the only healthy back, which could mean more designed QB runs in London.

NFL|00-0036442|pyd.note: The low line reflects Ja'Marr Chase in concussion protocol and Tee Higgins (adductor) missing Wednesday practice; Burrow has averaged about 293 yards this season with both available.

NFL|00-0038597|car.note: Brown had 9 carries and 11 catches in Week 4 and averages 3.6 yards per carry; as a 6.5-point favorite with banged-up receivers, Cincinnati could lean on the run more.

NFL|00-0038128|cmp.note: Willis remains Miami's starter; he has completed 15, 14, 20 and 9 passes at about 56 percent this season, managing just 9 completions in the Week 4 loss.

NFL|00-0037834|att.note: Purdy has thrown 34, 22, 27 and 30 passes this season with no injury listed; San Francisco is a 3.5-point road underdog in Seattle, so a trailing script could add some volume.

NFL|00-0035685|ryd.note: Montgomery ran 11 times for 33 yards in Week 3 and 10 for 24 in Week 4 while splitting work with Woody Marks, who has been scoring.

NFL|00-0040676|ptd.note: Ward has a passing TD in 3 of 4 games and Saleh rejected benching him, but Tennessee is a 7.5-point underdog in a game totaled near 37.

NFL|00-0038997|rec.note: The line is up because Alec Pierce is on IR and Keenan Allen (groin) sat Week 4, making Downs the top receiver, though he caught only 2, 7, 5 and 3 passes this season.

NFL|00-0040128|rec.note: Warren caught all 5 targets in Week 4 and has a 6-catch game; with Pierce on IR and Allen's groin status unclear, his target share should stay elevated.

NFL|00-0023459|att.note: Rodgers threw 40 passes in the Week 4 Thursday loss to Cleveland and is healthy on extra rest; Pittsburgh is about a 2.5-point favorite with a 44.5 total.

NFL|00-0036040|recyd.note: Johnson is the Saints' lead tight end on about 70 percent of snaps and has topped 50 receiving yards in all four games, with seven or more targets in three.

NFL|00-0035228|pyd.note: Murray is healthy and starting; his average is dragged down by a Week 1 concussion exit, with 168 and 247 yards in full games, and Jefferson (ankle) hopes to return.

NFL|00-0033293|rry.note: The line is high because Jordan Mason (thumb) went on IR; since then Jones has averaged about 23 touches with 92 and 128 scrimmage yards in his last two games.

NFL|00-0037240|rec.note: Williams had 10 catches over Weeks 1-3 on a modest target share behind TeSlaa and LaPorta, then caught 6 for 102 when Goff threw 52 times in Week 4.

NFL|00-0033106|att.note: Goff threw 52 passes in last week's loss to Carolina, and Detroit plays indoors at Arizona as a 5.5-point favorite with a 54.5 total.

NFL|00-0039139|rry.note: The 134.5 line sits well above his recent output; Gibbs managed 77 scrimmage yards against Carolina in Week 4 while Detroit leaned heavily on the pass.

NFL|00-0036275|car.note: Swift lost a fumble in Week 4 and did not return while Kyle Monangai ran 30 times for 146 yards and two scores; a split backfield is expected at Green Bay.

NFL|00-0039919|recyd.note: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is ruled out so Tyson Bagent starts again; Odunze had a season-best 6 catches for 94 yards with Bagent last week but otherwise has not topped 52 yards.

NFL|00-0040784|ryd.note: Judkins is averaging about 3.1 yards per carry this season with no injury tag; the Jets are a 1.5-point favorite in a low 39.5-total game.

NFL|00-0037740|rec.note: Wilson has caught 6, 5, 10 and 3 passes this season with no injury designation, in a game with a low 39.5 total.

NFL|00-0038542|rry.note: Bijan ran for 194 yards in Week 3 and 145 on 19 carries in Week 4 with Penix starting, and has no injury news.

NFL|00-0037746|car.note: Brian Robinson is Bijan's backup after signing in March; he got 10 carries in a Week 3 blowout, and no news was found explaining the higher line.

NFL|00-0033090|rec.note: Henry caught 5 of 5 targets on about 65 percent of snaps last game, and with Eli Raridon (ankle) hurt and Julian Hill on IR his workload could grow.

NFL|00-0034857|car.note: Allen took a hit to his left knee against the Chargers but finished the game, coaches were unconcerned, and he was reportedly not on Wednesday's injury report.

NFL|00-0039075|recyd.note: Nacua missed time with a hip/groin issue and returned with 9 catches for 125 yards, but he is reportedly managing a pre-hernia that could flare up or require surgery.

NFL|00-0040730|rry.note: Harvey led Denver backs with 29 snaps and caught all 10 targets for 93 scrimmage yards in Week 4; he leads the team in catches and WR Pat Bryant is hurt.

NFL|00-0040666|ryd.note: Hampton's carry share fell to 28 percent in Week 4 as Keaton Mitchell out-carried him in a three-way split, though he cleared 38.5 rushing yards in each of the last two games.

NFL|00-0036309|rec.note: Mooney is the Giants' slot receiver after Calvin Austin's ACL tear and caught exactly 2 passes in each of Weeks 1-3 on about 44 percent of snaps.
